rows.rationale: Accept partial: calibrated two-dimensional image sequence and scaled arrows directly operationalize the official stroboscope/video velocity representation. Full independent projectile-model fitting is not attributed to grade 8.
Accept partial: graphical velocity-change construction has a direct official basis. This does not assert the single target literally covers every inverse construction of before/after velocities.

Accept partial: guided planning, personal sensor OR video acquisition and acceleration evaluation retain the official supported experiment. Finite windows, safe straight motion and a changed trial are authored operationalizations; video is not a universal official requirement.

Accept three partial relationships: acquisition/graphs, accelerated-motion representations and calibrated digital video analysis jointly have direct source support. Full projectile validation and t-a representations are additional target content, not verbatim demands of this clause; the wider current Ph10.3 also explicitly includes projectile experiments.

Accept partial amplifier addition: live official NTG content explicitly includes personal transistor switching and amplifier experiments. Supervised fully specified DC circuitry is a scoped operationalization, not proof of the full independent official NTG competence or applicability to every Bavarian profile.

limits: No whole-source completion or classroom effectiveness claim.
Does not dispose of the separate newly discovered Ph8.1 resistance gap or the pending precision relationship.
